For assisted reproduction, doses of cetrorelix acetate equivalent to cetrorelix 250 micrograms daily may be given either in the morning begin- ning on day 5 or 6 of ovarian stimulation or in the evening begin- ning on day 5, and continued until ovulation induction. Alterna- tively a single dose equivalent to 3 mg of cetrorelix may be given on day 7; if follicle growth does not allow ovulation induction within 4 days, additional doses of cetrorelix 250 micrograms once daily may be given until the day of ovulation induction. ◊ References. 1.
